$comment: Hand-curated 'what we learned tonight' notes, surfaced on the homepage LEARNINGS band. Editorial signal that the project is improving even before there's traffic. Add new notes at top; cap at ~12 (older ones drop off the visible list but stay in the file for the record).

notes.title: The hero slot should be whatever shipped most recently — block OR feature.
notes.body: Until last night the homepage lead was always the latest content block. Mike landed on a 1-day-old block while 12 PRs had merged in between. Fix: pick latest of (block, ship), use whichever is newer. Each merge auto-promotes itself to hero. Keeps the front door honest about momentum.

notes.title: CSS-animated children inherit the parent's transform.
notes.body: Bar v6.3 ambient emotes are <span> children of the walker/pet/companion/peer parents. The parents have a 60s walk animation. The emotes ride along with no per-frame JS — they pop above and float up via their own keyframes, but the horizontal motion is FREE. ~12 lines of JS for the entire ambient-social system.

notes.title: HTML class as a feature flag is the cleanest opt-in.
notes.body: Walking bar v6 reads pc:bar:v6 from localStorage and toggles .bar-v6-on on the html element. Components self-hide via :global(html.bar-v6-on) selectors. No build flag, no per-route mounting, no SSR mismatch. Inline script in BlockLayout reads the flag pre-paint to avoid a flash. Whole system: ~6 lines of code.

notes.title: Floating chrome stacks fast on mobile.
notes.body: Bottom-right had message-mike trigger (124px from bottom) + cr-log chip (58px) + footer (0). They overlapped page content and pushed the message button up further. Fix: hide cr-log entirely on mobile (it's not useful when alone anyway), shrink message-mike to a 44px circle, repack. Mobile bottom-right is precious real estate — guard it.

notes.title: import.meta.glob is the right tool for build-time route discovery.
notes.body: We had ~376 hand-curated places + ~9 routes that slipped through. Globbing src/pages/**/*.{astro,md,ts} at build time lets us diff against the curated set and surface unfiled routes automatically. Editorial shape stays opinionated; nothing slips.

notes.title: PresenceRoom DO accepts arbitrary room keys.
notes.body: The walking bar is global (not per-page) so we open a WebSocket to /api/room?url=/__bar__ — synthetic key. The DO doesn't care it's not a real route. One line of client code, zero new server work, cross-page presence.

notes.title: You don't need per-frame position sync for shared loops.
notes.body: Cross-visitor walking bar: each peer's bar runs the same 60s CSS walk on its own clock with a randomized animation-delay. They look like they're moving together because the loop is identical, not because they broadcast. Cheap, no animation thrash.

notes.title: Don't bloat one localStorage key when two will do.
notes.body: pc:me:v1 (identity-and-day) and pc:inventory:v1 (gear) are separate. The /me reset button doesn't touch inventory — identity churn shouldn't wipe your gear list. Same for pc:pet:v1, pc:streak. Reset semantics drove the split.

notes.title: Operating mode IN FLIGHT and RECENT SHIPS are different contracts.
notes.body: Stale plans in operating-mode.json ("studio publish hardening — queued" still showing weeks after shipping) misled visitors. Now: open work lives in operating-mode.json, ships move out to recent-ships.json on merge. Two files, clean handoff.

notes.title: Tailwind v4 @theme tokens don't auto-emit as runtime :root vars.
notes.body: Bit us when community pills tried var(--color-ink) and got transparent. Fix: hardcode hex literals for components that need explicit theme values. Document the gotcha in code comments so the next agent doesn't re-discover it.

notes.title: Detached CF Pages git connector still costs us 2-3 min per merge.
notes.body: 4 manual `wrangler pages deploy` tonight. Each deploy uploads ~1140 new files (the asset hashes change every build). Reconnecting the dashboard webhook is the one fix Mike actually has to do — agents can't fix it. Surfaced as INCIDENT in operating-mode.

notes.title: Right-click is a real affordance if you label it.
notes.body: Pet adoption uses right-click on a companion. Two things made it discoverable: (1) the title attribute says "+cat · right-click to keep as pet", (2) a toast confirms when you do it. Without the label nobody finds it; with the label it feels secret-but-fair.
